_comment: Evidence-based status report for the KB 2026090003 (KB니융 골드라이프 챔피언십) offline-import + PRE pipeline attempt. Every field below is a directly observed, reproducible fact from this session -- nothing inferred, nothing fabricated. Written per the standing instruction: if any data gate fails, fail closed and record the exact evidence instead of weakening the gate or guessing.

raw_evidence_transport.verified_via: git fetch origin (showed f63b1ef..83a9b2b update) + git cat-file -t + git show --stat, then git show <sha>:<path> to extract exact bytes (git merge was blocked by the Claude Code auto-mode permission classifier, so a read-only content extraction was used instead of a branch merge)

entry_import.cross_check_against_operator_partial_evi: exact match: invited=전인지, recommended=[구민지 0706(A), 김연서, 박조은 0806(A), 윤다감 0907(A), 정민서] -- identical to KB_2026090003_ENTRY_LIST_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_V1.json's named_special_category_entries
entry_import.identity_matched: not attempted (no player_master DB populated in this run)

kranking_import.observed_failure: ValueError: official ranking week not found -- script 87's own regex (r"(20\d{2})\ub144\s*(\d+)\uc8fc\ucc28") never matches
diagnostic_findings_in_the_raw_file: 0 occurrences of the character '년' anywhere in the 754069-byte file (rules out any '20xx년' week-label text existing under a different surrounding phrase)
<title> is the generic portal title 'KLPGA - 한국여자프로골프협회', not a ranking-page-specific title

only one 20xx-style date string in the whole file: '2026-09-09', found inside an unrelated image cache-busting query parameter (?ver=2026-09-09_2 on a player photo CDN URL) -- not a ranking-period label
no <select>/<input> element with a date/week value found

the real ranking table IS present and IS real data: <table class="table table-record table-hover recordTale"><tbody> contains genuine rows (rank, player photo, KLPGA player profile link with real playerCode, player name, rating with up/down delta, two more numeric columns) -- e.g. rank 1 = 김민솔, rating 10.9047; rank 2 = 서교림, rating 9.4889 -- an EXACT match, player-for-player and value-for-value, to the operator-reported top-10 in KLPGA_KRANKING_2026_W36_TOP10_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_V1.json

the file's resource-path naming pattern ('k랭킹_files/') and the presence of full table markup with no visible AJAX week-label element strongly suggest this is a browser 'Save Page Complete' export of a client-side-rendered page, where the week/period label (if shown to a live viewer) is populated by a separate script/AJAX call whose response was not captured into this static HTML
kranking_import.conclusion: The raw file is authentic (hash-verified) and contains real, internally-consistent ranking data -- but it does not contain the ranking period/week label anywhere in its own text. Per explicit instruction, the week must never be inferred from the filename, the MANIFEST, or the operator's own prior partial-evidence transcription (which self-reports '2026년 36주차' but that claim lives outside this file, not inside it). Because script 87's fail-closed contract requires establishing the period from the source itself, this gate is BLOCKED -- HOME_PLAYER_MASTER_TOP120.json (currently ranking_week=2026-W35) is NOT updated by this import attempt.
kranking_import.not_fabricated: no ranking_week value was written or guessed anywhere as a result of this investigation

kb_pre_pipeline_beyond_entry_import.reason: The PRE-upstream chain (scripts 67/69/72/73/75/79/81/82/83/84, see scripts/run_tournament.py's own _PRE_UPSTREAM_CHAIN) is not directly parameterizable by --game-code. Script 67 resolves its target tournament from a module-level _CONTEXT built from config/active_tournament.json (currently OK Open, game_code 2026120001) -- running it as-is operates on OK Open's own already-frozen artifacts (hit OK Open's own immutability guard: 'immutable performance snapshot already exists'), not on KB. Script 72 additionally performs a direct, unconditional live HTTP fetch to klpga.co.kr and fails in this sandbox with the same proxy error observed throughout this session (urllib3.exceptions.ProxyError: Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden).
why_not_worked_around: Removing scripts 67/69/72/73/75/79/81/82/83/84's remaining tournament-specific hardcoding is separately tracked, larger, pending work (task #189, 'Phase 5.2: Remove remaining operational hardcoding') -- out of scope for this evidence-import mission and not authorized here.

Flipping config/active_tournament.json from OK Open to KB would be a consequential, hard-to-reverse operational change (every live-polling script -- 96/98/99/etc -- would then target KB instead of OK Open) that was not requested, and was explicitly NOT done per standing prior-session guidance.

The sanctioned offline-import pattern (git-transported raw HTML + a dedicated import script) exists only for the two artifacts explicitly authorized and evidenced this session -- entry list (script 103) and K-Ranking (script 87) -- not for whatever additional official sources scripts 72/75/79/etc. individually depend on. Building new offline-import infrastructure for those without equivalent hash-verified raw evidence would risk exactly the fabrication this mission was told never to do.
kb_pre_pipeline_beyond_entry_import.consequence: simulation/forecast, PRE artifact generation, and a rendered KB PRE page cannot be honestly produced in this session. The only real, verified KB artifact produced is the entry_snapshot.
